L0·N7501unmasked layer
This early-layer neuron is mostly a suppression unit (range −2.5 to +0.3) whose weak "positive" end lands on capitalized clause/sentence-opening words in promotional web copy ("Full", "Regardless", "Sometimes", "County") and the mojibake curly-quote token "âĢĿ", while it is strongly driven negative by content nouns/proper nouns such as "Minneapolis", "Fellowship", "assignments", "Click" — i.e. it looks like a token-identity contrast rather than a coherent semantic detector.
